scope: Qualified Inkscape1.4.4 explicit and intent-driven DAG technical diagrams: deterministic rank/lane/card/page policy, native glyph fit and geometry readback, generated editable SVG and RGBA8 PNG probes, semantic/integrity/lifecycle checks, common two-state analytic card budgets and twelve concurrent isolated native runs. No general DAG routing optimiser, arbitrary imported SVG, font-size search, live editor or whole-image fidelity guarantee.
acceptance: Run tools/qualify_inkscape.py on the target executable; require native bounds, label fit, decoded page dimensions/colour probes, tamper rejection and lifecycle checks.
